description: Honest comparison of the frozen submission (code/) and the two-stage experiment (experiments/two_stage/). Cross-validation refits every component inside each fold on the training split only; totals are over three fold assignments (seeds 0, 1, 2), 3 x 2114 hard training questions. Validation is the 355 hard validation questions. Test is the complete 467-question bank, scored once per frozen checkpoint with the official scorer.

submission_linear_only.what: code/ pipeline, pairwise least-squares ridge on centered embedding + agreement, lambda 1 (code/checkpoint/ablations/embed_agree)

submission_linear_plus_numeric_residual.what: code/ pipeline with the in-sample numeric-answer residual, scale 0.5, no checks

submission_full.what: code/checkpoint/model_bundle: linear + numeric residual + arithmetic penalty 0.2 + expression-coverage override (prototype residual omitted in CV; it changed no test choice's correctness)

two_stage_stage1_centered.what: experiments/two_stage/checkpoint/ablations/stage1_centered: pairwise logistic ridge on centered embedding + agreement, lambda 0.1

two_stage_full.what: experiments/two_stage/checkpoint/model_bundle: stage-1 centered + absolute logistic rankers, stage-2 logistic on out-of-fold stage-1 scores, 73 trace features (raw and within-question centered), 17 numeric-answer features

notes: The validation numbers of the submission pipeline were used to choose its numeric scale, penalty and coverage settings, so they are optimistic; the two-stage validation numbers were not used for any choice.
Stage 2 adds +64 hard training questions over three seeds in cross-validation (about 1.0 point) and +5 test questions (380 -> 385, about 1.1 points): the stage-2 gain transfers as predicted.

The submission's numeric residual, penalty and coverage override add +10 test questions (381 -> 391) but -12 in cross-validation (5125 -> 5113). Cross-validation does not support that gain; it is within the sampling noise of a 467-question bank.

Difference between 391 and 385 on 467 questions is 6 questions. The two frozen selectors choose a different final number on 48 test questions (a different candidate index on 108); with 48 discordant questions the standard error of the difference in correct counts is about 6 questions, so the gap is within sampling noise.
